additional_info.subject: RE: ID0394070-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P9 312561850/02] Black Screen CRM:00797001544
additional_info.body:
Dear RC-FR Team,
The customer reported that they performed an intervention and noticed a black screen issue. We also checked the charger on SCB, and it is currently online with no active error flags.
Note:
Kindly check the 'RC to end customer' warranty before initiating the activity. Also, regarding the warranty decision, please note that this topic does not fall under NOC. It will be handled separately by the warranty claim manager or the warranty team.
A site intervention should be planned to inspect the connections, as there may be a loose connection between KF1 and PH2. Please ensure that the DPP and USB connections used for the OC display and touch functionality are properly checked. Additionally, verify the supply voltage (24V).
There is also a possibility that the DPP or USB cable may be faulty. We recommend swapping them with working cables to confirm the issue. During the site visit, please carry a spare HMI, DPP, and USB cables in case replacements are needed.
Kindly refer to the marked HMI schematic below and also review the attached Q-feedback for troubleshooting.
https://support.industry.siemens.com/cs/document/109816666/si-e-q-feedback-q2302-sicharge-d-hmi-backlight-off-and-scrambled-image-due-to-router-emissions?dti=0&lc=en-WW
Please note, if the charger's DLogic is Gen2, the Q-feedback process will not apply. If all the checkpoints have been verified and the problem persists, then HMI replacement needs to be planned. Please refer to the attached document for spare parts if needed.
